name: @magpie-community/page-getbb
description: A page in magpie's window with your bb (getbb.app) threads: which are running, which wait for you, which failed, grouped by project, each opened in bb with one click; import.mjs puts every bb thread in magpie's Sessions and Memory, and every bb memory in Memory

summary.en: Your bb (getbb.app) threads in magpie's window: running, waiting for you or failed, by project, each opened in bb with one click. Reads the bb CLI on this computer.
summary.zh: 在 magpie 窗口里看 bb（getbb.app）的线程：正在运行、等你回复或出错的，按项目分组，一键在 bb 里打开。读取本机的 bb 命令行。
